title: Above-1.5 C rise in global temperatures unavoidable – UN report
summary: It is imminent and unavoidable that the rise in global temperatures above preindustrial levels will exceed 1.5 C due to decades of insufficient climate action, a U.N. Environment Program report said…

blocks.text: It is imminent and unavoidable that the rise in global temperatures above preindustrial levels will exceed 1.5 C due to decades of insufficient climate action, a U.N. Environment Program report said Wednesday, calling for urgent emissions cuts to minimize the magnitude and duration of overshoot. To achieve the “lowest possible” temperature overshoot scenario with a peak rise of 1.7-1.8 C before returning to or below 1.5 C by 2100, UNEP said that global greenhouse gas emissions would have to be reduced by 18 percent from the 2025 level by 2030, 45 percent by 2035 and 69 percent by 2040.
